decisions.rationale: Diff grants auditors deletion permission, contradicting the administrator-or-owner specification; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII input, strip plus casefold implements the required trimming and lowercasing; the committed test passes.
Non-empty behavior satisfies the specification and its test passes, but intended empty-sequence behavior is explicitly unspecified and cannot be validated.
Candidate returns zero instead of raising ConfigError for malformed or out-of-range input; the malformed-input test fails.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the committed total test fails.

strategy_update: Continue grounding verdicts in exact diffs, specifications, and permitted tests; abstain when an asserted intent is explicitly unspecified.
